issues.description: The UML in the problem statement indicates numberOfLoopings as a private attribute (shown with '-' in RollerCoaster), but the solution declares numberOfLoopings as protected. This deviates from the UML-specified visibility and may confuse students about the expected attribute visibility and encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML by declaring numberOfLoopings as private and providing the public getter (as already present). Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to indicate protected visibility if intentional. Ensure the template and solution use the same visibility to avoid student confusion.
